concept: SEC EDGAR amended annual-report form type

row.concept: SEC EDGAR amended annual-report form type
row.description: SEC EDGAR form types identify an annual report as "10-K" and append the optional revision marker "/A" when the filing is an amendment.

neighbors.difference: 10-Q is the quarterly-report form type; its amended form is 10-Q/A.
8-K reports current events and has a different filing purpose and structure.

row.wrong_generalization: Assuming every annual report is amended, or allowing an arbitrary slash suffix, loses the specific optional EDGAR amendment convention.

row.description: The FIX Protocol Parties component starts with NoPartyIDs (tag 453) and then repeats PartyID, PartyIDSource, and PartyRole fields for each named party. This simplified structural form uses BIC-like PartyID values and visible pipe delimiters.

neighbors.difference: Instrument identifies the traded security rather than counterparties or executing parties.
SWIFT FIN fields use colon-tagged message fields, not FIX tag-value repeating groups.

row.wrong_generalization: Flattening all FIX tags into one unordered map would discard repeated party instances; production validation must also verify that tag 453 matches the number of repeated groups.
